versions.changelog:
- Summary: Now delivers one concise, savage roast per input instead of multi-part responses.
- Updated the description and workflow to reflect single-line output.
- Added input language detection step in the workflow.
- Simplified example output to match the new single-roast style.
- Clarified messaging throughout for a more focused, sharable user experience.

Savage Roast AI 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Instantly generates sharp, meme-worthy internet-style roasts for any user-provided text.
- Supports bilingual descriptions and usage instructions (English/Chinese).
- Designed for use in social media, friend banter, and pure entertainment.
- No external dependencies; uses OpenClaw’s built-in AI capabilities.
- Delivers brutally honest, emotionally impactful, and highly shareable roasts.
